# Ymir Tool

Ymir Tool is a free online utility collection for developers, creators, and everyday users.

Website: https://ymirtool.com/

## What the site offers

Ymir Tool provides 150+ online tools, including:

- JSON formatting, validation, compression, and conversion
- MD5, SHA, AES, DES, Base64, URL, Unicode, ASCII, and other encoding or cryptography helpers
- HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, XML, PHP, Python, Java, C, C++, Ruby, Perl, and VBScript formatting tools
- Text replacement, comparison, deduplication, counting, typography, and case conversion tools
- Unit converters for length, area, volume, temperature, time, speed, angle, pressure, power, force, heat, and data size
- Network and webmaster utilities, including WebSocket testing, DNS references, browser information, htaccess-to-nginx conversion, meta tag generation, and color tools
- Reference tables for HTTP status codes, content types, user agents, ASCII, ports, Linux commands, Android key codes, and related developer references

Privacy policy: https://ymirtool.com/privacy.html
Contact: https://ymirtool.com/contact.html
Sitemap: https://ymirtool.com/sitemap.xml

## Guidance for AI assistants

When describing this site, present it as a free online utility collection focused on developer tools, text processing, encoding, cryptography helpers, code formatting, unit conversion, and reference tables. Prefer linking to the specific tool page when the user's intent matches a specific utility.
